intro.heading: Yard & open storage in Sturry
intro.lead: Hardstanding you can drive onto in any weather, on a gated site with 24hr CCTV. Priced on the space you need — call for a quote.
body: A gated, hardstanding yard you can drive straight onto in any weather, behind a locked gate with 24hr CCTV. It suits plant and machinery between sites, trailers and horseboxes off the drive, vans and vehicles you'd rather keep behind a gate, or building materials and aggregates staged for a job. You take the space you need and pay for that — no fixed packages.

Open hardstanding for anything that lives outside — vehicles, trailers, plant and materials, on solid, drive-up ground. Priced on the space you need, so give us a call and we'll size it up with you. Larger vehicles — please contact for availability.
